Theatrical release from September 25th 2026.
Baanali Jaarida, a beautiful romantic duet from Premada Oorali, capturing the dreamy world of Santosh (Shreeraam) and Rukmini (Thapaswini Poonacha). It's a romantic duet that celebrates the feeling of falling in love — when every breeze becomes poetry, every moment becomes a dream, and two hearts begin their journey together.
Song Credits :
Song: Baanali Jaarida...
Music Director: Sunaad Gowtham
Singer : Ninaada Nayak, Rajat Hegde
Lyrics : Abhijith Thirthahalli
